description: A modern detached home with a flat-roof design and walls of floor-to-ceiling sliding glass. The entry opens through an oversized glass pivot door to a bright open-concept living area with pot lights, a dark stone feature wall and a wood-panelled media wall. The kitchen has a large centre island with cooktop and stainless hood, a side-by-side fridge, built-in wall oven and microwave, a wine fridge and skylights. The primary bedroom has wide-plank wood floors, a plaster accent wall, sliding doors to the pool deck and a walk-in closet with built-in shelving and a centre island. Outside, a lit in-ground pool with attached spa sits beside a stone patio with an outdoor dining area, behind a cable railing with an elevated view over city lights.
highlights: Kitchen island with wine fridge and skylights

review_notes: Setting does not look like Ontario: hillside panorama over a large city (photos 5, 7) and the daytime view in photo 5 looks like a coastal basin with distant towers; Ottawa has no comparable hillside city-lights view. Consider dropping the view highlight or swapping photo 7.
Snake plants planted outdoors at the entry (photo 1) and year-round open-air indoor/outdoor living are not typical of Ontario's climate.
Photo 1 shows a real-looking house number ('9315') on the wall; it does not match the invented address and could identify the original property. Consider cropping or swapping.

Photos 2 and 4 show the same grand piano and the interiors are stylistically continuous, so this set looks like one real property shoot rather than several photographers; please confirm each image's licence when filling credits.json.
Only one bedroom and no bathrooms are shown; beds 3 / baths 3 / 4,200 sqft are plausible guesses for a home this size, not verified by photos.
Photo 6 (walk-in closet) is labelled room_type 'other' since there is no closet type; the fire feature in photo 4 is partly obscured, so it is described generically.
Piano, guitars, TVs, patio heaters and furniture are treated as staging and left out of the copy.
